name: BUSCAP
recent: Bus Cap Berhad 近期与 StarCharge Energy 签署两年合作协议，扩展电动车充电基础设施与综合出行生态。公司董事在10月期间多次申报持股变动，且交易所对其股价异常波动发出 UMA 询问。最新季度（2026年6月30日止）营收 2694.7 万令吉，净利 207 万令吉。
notable: 与 StarCharge Energy 签署两年合作协议，发展电动车充电基础设施。
交易所就股价异常波动发出 UMA 询问。
董事 Puan Aliza Binti Ashari 在10月多次申报出售股份。
risks: 交易所就股价异常波动发出 UMA 询问。
董事 Puan Aliza Binti Ashari 在10月多次出售股份。
董事 Puan Rose Zilawati Binti Mohamed Arifin 在10月出售股份。
earnings: 2026年6月30日止季度营收 2694.7 万令吉，净利 207 万令吉，净利率 7.7%。

recent_en: Bus Cap Berhad recently signed a two-year collaboration with StarCharge Energy to expand EV charging infrastructure and an integrated mobility ecosystem. Directors filed multiple shareholding change notices in October, and the exchange issued an UMA query on unusual market activity. Latest quarter (ended 30 June 2026) revenue was MYR 26.947 million with net profit of MYR 2.07 million.
notable_en: Signed a two-year collaboration agreement with StarCharge Energy to develop EV charging infrastructure.
The exchange issued an UMA query on unusual market activity.
Director Puan Aliza Binti Ashari filed multiple notices of share disposals in October.
risks_en: The exchange issued an UMA query on unusual market activity.
Director Puan Aliza Binti Ashari disposed of shares multiple times in October.
Director Puan Rose Zilawati Binti Mohamed Arifin disposed of shares in October.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was MYR 26.947 million and net profit was MYR 2.07 million, with a net margin of 7.7%.
